profile: Eli Lilly discovers, develops, manufactures, and markets human pharmaceutical products. Its medicines address cardiometabolic conditions, including diabetes and obesity, as well as cancer and other diseases. Products include insulin therapies and medicines such as Mounjaro, Zepbound, Cyramza, and Erbitux. The company distributes its products through facilities in the United States, Europe, and Asia, and sells them in countries worldwide.
